diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in 'Not specified' or default values for the critical decision variables, failing to trigger any content checks. The model defaulted to a generic maintenance schedule on Day 1 and Day 2 based only on public facts (S1-S4), completely ignoring the specific timing and quantity requirements contained in the hidden facts PF1 and PF2.

fix_instructions: To ensure the scenario requires multi-agent coordination, increase the complexity of the public information so that the default/generic decisions are clearly incorrect or insufficient. Specifically, tighten C1, C2, C5 (dependent on PF1) and C3, C4, C6, C7 (dependent on PF2) by requiring precise time windows or specific gallon amounts that cannot be guessed from the public facts S1-S5.
